## Question or result / Вопрос или результат

## Commit and command / Коммит и команда

## Environment / Окружение

- GPU / VRAM:
- OS / Python:
- PyTorch / CUDA / driver:
- Precision and attention backend:

## Experimental conditions / Условия

- Dataset and hashes:
- Tokenizer and context length:
- Seeds, model dimensions, parameter counts:
- Update/time budget and what the timing includes:

## Raw measurements / Исходные измерения

Attach JSON or link to a small reproducible result. Include losses, throughput, memory, and all seeds, not only the best run. Do not include credentials or private training data.
